items.anchor: the existing construction contracts supply orbit existence and all-query containment.
items.note: Both negative constructions: the supplement says "The D and L construction contracts supply those separate facts" (editorial/narrative_rebuild/negative_scaling.lean:5) and FORMAL_SUPPLEMENTS.json "orbit existence and all-query containment remain separate D/L contracts". D construction: orbit existence for the seed run produced by the specified search (A/failure/disp/010) and the embedded runs (disp/025); all-query containment: every accepted and rejected query of the embedded runs lies in the slab of the local model (disp/026) and in a ball shrinking to the minimizer (disp/028), as the transfer (prose/036) requires. L construction: the perturbed bad orbit of Proposition art:quadratic_failure is produced by the implementation for every admissible pair, with every accepted and rejected query in the given neighbourhood V (orbit existence and containment); the copy runs exist for every pair and every n (A/lower_curvature/disp/021); each copy query is the scaled seed query and lies in the local domain of the model (A/lower_curvature/prose/028; review F1).
